plantCareTips.title: Watering
plantCareTips.description: Water your plants in the morning to reduce evaporation and help them absorb water throughout the day.

plantCareTips.title: Fertilizing
plantCareTips.description: Apply fertilizer every two weeks during the growing season to keep your plants healthy and thriving.

plantCareTips.title: Air Circulation
plantCareTips.description: Ensure good air circulation around plants to prevent fungal diseases.

plantCareTips.title: Pest Control
plantCareTips.description: Inspect your plants regularly for pests, and remove any infested leaves or stems immediately.

plantCareTips.title: Pruning
plantCareTips.description: Prune dead or damaged leaves to encourage new growth and maintain plant health.

plantCareTips.title: Sunlight
plantCareTips.description: Make sure your plants get the right amount of sunlight. Some plants need full sun, while others prefer shade.

plantCareTips.title: Soil Quality
plantCareTips.description: Use well-draining soil and add compost or organic matter to enrich the soil and provide nutrients.

plantCareTips.title: Mulching
plantCareTips.description: Apply a layer of mulch around the base of the plants to retain moisture, regulate soil temperature, and suppress weeds.
